hypotheses.claim: Recurrence continuation cannot be robustly inferred from one first-order state-delta scalar; multi-step trajectory geometry plus residual pressure will better discriminate converging, oscillatory/productive-cycle, stalled and diverging regimes.
hypotheses.expected_observation: At matched compute, a trajectory-aware continuation controller reduces false halts and overthinking relative to scalar-delta control.
hypotheses.test: Frozen-output H1 replay comparing state_delta-only, R7 dual-gate and R8 trajectory-aware continuation across regime-labeled episodes.
hypotheses.falsifier: State-delta plus residual-pressure control matches or exceeds trajectory-aware control on held-out correctness, false halt, overthinking and cost.

hypotheses.claim: Required recurrent depth is conditional on available working-state capacity; workspace/scratchpad/receiver-memory capacity and recurrence depth can partially substitute, with both undercapacity and dilution/overcapacity failure regimes possible.
hypotheses.expected_observation: The best continuation threshold/depth shifts systematically when state capacity changes while task and model are held fixed.
hypotheses.test: Factorial H1/Qwen-class replay over low/medium/high state capacity and fixed/adaptive recurrence budgets with matched task families.
hypotheses.falsifier: Capacity state adds no held-out predictive/intervention value for depth, outcome or stability beyond task/model features.

hypotheses.claim: Recurrence receipts should separate semantic-state equivalence, state/version equivalence and execution-trace equivalence; treating all three as one identity will misclassify retry/churn as cognitive progress or hide materially different histories.
hypotheses.expected_observation: Matched episodes exist with equal semantic state but unequal version/trace identities and with trace-only retry changes that should not count as semantic progress.
hypotheses.test: Bind GWT recurrence receipts to Harness oracle semantic_state_hash/state_version_hash/trace_root_hash and replay retry, regrouping, crash/restart and idempotent cases.
hypotheses.falsifier: A single identity representation preserves all required recurrence, recovery, freshness and semantic-progress decisions with lower complexity and no additional errors.

hypotheses.claim: Pairwise transfer-entropy/directed-flow readouts are screening evidence only when higher-order joint causation is plausible; conditioned multivariate or higher-order tests are required before a flow-based emergence promotion.
hypotheses.expected_observation: Constructed/common-driver and XOR-like controls produce pairwise false-positive or false-negative interpretations that multivariate controls resolve.
hypotheses.test: H1 synthetic causal motifs plus matched intervention/lesion/rescue using pairwise and multivariate estimators.
hypotheses.falsifier: Pairwise measures plus the existing intervention battery resolve all preregistered higher-order motifs without material ambiguity or added false conclusions.

hypotheses.claim: Existing ClayCode G9 semantic machinery can represent the R8 readout without new surface syntax; R8 should be a typed semantic-contract extension, not a language redesign.
hypotheses.expected_observation: LoopDynamicsReadoutR8 and RecurrenceDecision compile through the existing record/tensor/rule/type-effect surface after current BASE parser closure.
hypotheses.test: Compile canonical R8 contract through the real repository parser -> canonical typed IR -> type/effect -> evaluator/lowering path.
hypotheses.falsifier: A minimal R8 contract exposes an executable semantic requirement that current G9 cannot express without a new primitive.

hypotheses.claim: R7's admission-versus-continuation split remains necessary even after trajectory/capacity observables are added; richer observability should refine the continuation gate rather than collapse both decisions into one scalar.
hypotheses.expected_observation: Dual-gate trajectory-aware control dominates or matches an overloaded single score under mixed easy/hard and interruption-sensitive tasks.
hypotheses.test: Matched-compute fixed-budget vs one-gate vs R7 dual-gate vs R8 dual-gate-plus-trajectory/capacity replay.
hypotheses.falsifier: One calibrated gate or fixed budget matches/exceeds R8 across preregistered utility, safety and cost metrics.

counterhypotheses.claim: State delta plus residual pressure is already sufficient; trajectory geometry adds estimator noise and cost without useful control signal.
The depth-state/memory trade-off is architecture/task specific and should remain inside the model; exposing system-GWT capacity fields will not improve FRANK control.
Three identity layers are unnecessary for GWT; ordinary episode id plus semantic state is sufficient and the Harness split should remain a persistence concern only.
Higher-order estimators are too data-hungry/noisy for operational use; pairwise measures plus direct interventions provide better practical evidence.
Ordinary event-driven orchestration with explicit queues, budgets and retries explains any gains, so GWT-specific continuation remains unnecessary.
